items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: And I met Gary McFarland, later I went down to New York.

ctx.x: It was like a stereotype. I don’t want to go there but it seemed like that’s exactly what’s happening. And I was already talked up before I got there. So I said, “Wait a minute I just got here and I’m not sure.” “It’s okay, it’s okay, you’ll be fine.” Needless to say I was in the band, again the only black musician in the whole band. Through that we did a festival at Villanova. And it was televised on PBS. And Gary McFarland watched it and wrote me a letter.
No kidding. I’ll be darned. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -5-
